reviews.title: This app is horrible
reviews.text: I would not recommend this to parents for their children, I would not recommend this to fans of my little pony, I would not recommend this to ANYONE, unless you have 6 dollars to burn A MONTH. Originally, this app had only special features locked behind a paywall, things like special paint colors (used in the “mini games” as well as fancy furniture that was OPTIONAL. as of right now, this game has locked EVERYTHING behind a monthly paywall. You cannot play this game without paying $6 a month. The game ALSO deleted my previous progress (as I was VERY far into the game) in order to instill this paywall that prevents you from playing. I would not even look this apps way when you can find much better coloring apps for free.
